tools.falsifier: REFUTED IF: glossary_book_sync_available reports no updates (the divergence did not seed, so the run measures nothing and must not read as a pass), OR the model reports the book is up to date, OR the apply lands with NO confirm card (Tier W), OR the model invents an item id rather than passing one sync_available returned.

answer_expect.why: Weak on the TEXT on purpose. The assertion is the trace: sync_available must return a non-empty diff and the apply must carry an id it returned. A reply discussing updates while the diff was empty is precisely the false pass this scenario exists to prevent.

ship_audit.gate: OWED — Tier W; the apply overwrites adopted book rows.
ship_audit.absent_case: an item id that does not exist must be refused — not covered here.
ship_audit.idempotency: applying the same item twice must be a no-op — not covered here.
ship_audit.tenancy: book-scoped; the read needs VIEW and the apply needs Manage.
